summary: Phase 2 AI Insights (analytics dashboards + AI Brain NL chat) — full backend + frontend verification against preview. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases passed on /api/ai/analytics, /api/ai/brain (number question 'how many total leads', bar question 'top callers by conversion rate'), /api/ai/brain/history, and caller-role RBAC on /api/ai/analytics (returns 403). analytics call ~1.5s, brain calls ~3–6s. Frontend: admin login → sidebar shows 'AI Insights' (data-testid=nav-ai-insights) → /ai-insights loads (data-testid=ai-insights-page). KPI cards render real numbers (Total 1,10,962; Converted 9,872; Rate 8.9%). All 6 advanced charts render SVGs — Conversion Funnel, Leads Trend (30d), Source Performance, Caller Performance, Ad Platform Pie, Top States. AI Brain: typed 'How many total leads do we have?' → user msg + thinking indicator + AI answer 'Total Leads: 110962 leads.' (chart hidden as expected for number). Typed 'Top callers by conversion rate' → answer with bar chart SVG rendered (top: Azhar 12.3%). Suggestion chip click → 'How many leads converted by source?' → answer with bar chart. No 500s. One unrelated console 401 (likely a background auth ping — not from ai routes).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai.py _extract_json uses greedy '\{.*\}' — fine for GPT-5.5 outputs but will fail on multiple JSON blocks; consider json parsing with fallback strip of code fences.
